query: a quick swarm master session just started
expected_behavior: Loads the quick-swarm-master skill before taking any other action, then follows the role seed to tell each engineer to wait for the operator.

query: a quick seat's agent exited and a shell history command points at its old launcher
expected_behavior: Explains the launcher script deletes itself once its agent exits, so that path is gone, then runs agentihooks quick status to check whether the seat is bound before relaunching it.

query: force a handoff of eng-1's quick seat
expected_behavior: Runs agentihooks quick relaunch eng-1 --folder <folder> --force to end eng-1's live agent with its pane kept and start its successor.

query: force a handoff of the quick swarm master's own seat
expected_behavior: States that a forced relaunch of the master seat returns master and starts nothing on current dev, then starts a successor by hand in the master's pane with its quick variables set and runs agentihooks quick relaunch master --folder <folder> --adopt from that pane.
